convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iMACD, iMA). Simple entry/exit rules with fixed lot sizing. External .mqh includes (Trade.mqh, SymbolInfo.mqh, PositionInfo.mqh, AccountInfo.mqh) are standard MT5 library wrappers for trade execution, not custom logic. No multi-timeframe, hedging, or grid logic.

derived_values.name: Adjusted point (m_adjusted_point)
derived_values.used_by: MACD open/close levels, trailing stop, take profit

other_exits: MACD signal crossover close: long closed when MACD_main crosses below MACD_signal while both above zero and MACD_main > m_macd_close_level; short closed when MACD_main crosses above MACD_signal while both below zero and |MACD_main| > m_macd_close_level

custom_logic_notes: 10-second timeout between trade operations (ExtTimeOut=10). Entry requires all conditions met simultaneously: MACD crossover + MACD above threshold + EMA trending in same direction. Long entry only when MACD_main<0 (below zero line), short entry only when MACD_main>0 (above zero line). Deviation in points is 3*digits_adjust (3 for 4-digit, 30 for 5-digit). Bar count guard: Bars > 2*InpMATrendPeriod before processing. Typo in source: m_traling_stop (should be m_trailing_stop). SL is 0.0 at entry for both long and short; only trailing stop modifies SL after position is profitable by InpTrailingStop pips.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Digit adjustment logic must be replicated: multiply SL/TP/levels by 10 for 5-digit/3-digit symbols. 2) MACD uses iMACD builtin with fast=12, slow=26, signal=9 on PRICE_CLOSE; EMA uses period=26 on PRICE_CLOSE. 3) Entry is a 3-condition AND: MACD crossover + MACD_above_threshold + EMA_trending. 4) Long entry only when MACD_main<0 zone; short only when MACD_main>0 zone. 5) No initial SL set (SL=0 at open); trailing stop activates when position is profitable by InpTrailingStop adjusted pips. 6) TP set at entry only. 7) Signal reversal close uses MACD crossover + threshold check. 8) Margin check via FreeMarginCheck before opening. 9) 10-second cooldown between trade operations. 10) Single position per symbol (position_gate=no_position). 11) Standard MT5 Trade library classes need Python equivalents for order placement and position management.
